subject: general
question: 6 : 42 :: 7.6 : x and 3 : 6 :: 6 : y. What is the ratio of x to y?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **Proportion** a : b :: c : d, the product of extremes equals the product of means (ad = bc).

Calculation for x: 6 × x = 42 × 7.6 ⇒ x = 7 × 7.6 = 53.2

Calculation for y: 3 × y = 6 × 6 ⇒ y = 12

Ratio x : y = 53.2 : 12 = 532 : 120 = 133 : 30

**∴ The correct answer is 133 : 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec0444ff50af536f6c6b21a1f99e692a2222d12bdccd39c411d8b5835611bb7d.png] 

**Given:** 6 : 42 :: 7.6 : x and 3 : 6 :: 6 : y

**Formula:** If a : b :: c : d, then a/b = c/d

⇒ 6/42 = 7.6/x

⇒ 1/7 = 7.6/x

⇒ x = 7.6 × 7 = 53.2

⇒ 3/6 = 6/y

⇒ 1/2 = 6/y

⇒ y = 6 × 2 = 12

⇒ x : y = 53.2 : 12

⇒ x : y = 532/10 : 12 = 532 : 120

⇒ x : y = 133 : 30

**∴ The correct answer is 133 : 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fourth Proportional

In the proportion a : b :: c : d, **d** is called the fourth proportional, calculated as d = (b × c) / a.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers **a** and **b** is √(a × b).

Third Proportional

If a : b :: b : c, then **c** is the third proportional, calculated as c = b² / a.</p
